test_title: English Proficiency Exam for Teaching Candidates

questions.question: By the time the semester ends, we ________ all the assigned material.
The school principal demanded that the new policy ________ immediately.
________ the difficult material, the students performed exceptionally well on the test.
Had I known about the teacher's meeting, I ________ it.
The professor, along with several of her graduate students, ________ to believe that the recent findings, while significant, ________ further investigation before they can be published.
She came to live here ________ a month ago.
The company needs to decide ________ and for all what its position is on this point.
The student denied ________ during the final exam.
________ her excellent references, she did not get the senior teaching position.
You ________ submit the lesson plans by Friday; it is a strict institute policy.
The lesson plan was highly ________; every activity logically flowed into the next.
A teacher needs a great deal of ________ when dealing with young or unmotivated learners.
The candidate was extremely nervous, but she answered all the interview questions ________.
The main ________ of the new textbook is its lack of real-world listening activities.
He has been teaching for over twenty years, so he has a great deal of ________ in the classroom.
The students' noticeable ________ in their speaking skills was a direct result of the new curriculum.
The lecture was long and ________, and by the end, most of the audience was struggling to stay awake.
Once the plane is in the air, you can ________ your seat belts if you wish.
There are ________ students enrolled in the advanced class this term than last term.
The principal praised the teacher for her unwavering ________ to her students and their success.
What is the main idea of the first paragraph?

options.A: The communicative approach is outdated and should be replaced.
options.B: The communicative approach is often misinterpreted as simply promoting unstructured talk.
options.C: Fluency is the most important part of language learning.
options.D: Teachers should not allow free conversation in the classroom.

questions.correct_answer_text: The communicative approach is often misinterpreted as simply promoting unstructured talk.

questions.question: The word "dominant" in paragraph 1 is closest in meaning to:
How many components of "communicative competence" are explicitly listed in the passage?
According to the passage, what is "sociolinguistic competence"?

options.A: The ability to form grammatically correct sentences.
options.B: The ability to use language appropriately in different social situations.
options.C: The ability to connect sentences into a larger text.
options.D: The ability to overcome a lack of vocabulary.

questions.correct_answer_text: The ability to use language appropriately in different social situations.

questions.question: According to the passage, a well-designed communicative activity must include:

options.A: A discussion about the students' personal lives.
options.B: A free-flowing conversation with no rules.
options.C: A clear goal and a reason to communicate.

questions.correct_answer_text: A clear goal and a reason to communicate.

questions.question: The word "former" in paragraph 3 refers to:

options.B: The teacher's role in the classroom.
options.C: The pair-work activity with the timetable and map.

questions.correct_answer_text: The pair-work activity with the timetable and map.

questions.question: Why does the author believe the "bus timetable and map" activity is more effective than a hobby discussion?

options.A: It is more fun for the students.
options.B: It forces students to interact to solve a specific problem.
options.C: It produces more spoken language overall.
options.D: It focuses exclusively on grammatical accuracy.

questions.correct_answer_text: It forces students to interact to solve a specific problem.

questions.question: The phrase "free-for-all" in paragraph 3 most likely means a situation that is:
According to the final paragraph, what is the primary role of a teacher in a communicative classroom?

options.A: To be the main speaker and model of the language.
options.B: To strictly correct every error students make.
options.C: To guide and support the students' communication.
options.D: To remove all challenges from the learning process.

questions.correct_answer_text: To guide and support the students' communication.

questions.question: What is the author's overall tone in the passage?

options.A: Critical and dismissive of modern teaching.
